content:
alex: FYI — GreenPeak (SI) just told us their APAC rack shipment got re-manifested; ETA slipped ~2 weeks. This impacts the NovaHealth private pilot we promised for week of 4/18. They want confirmation we can still meet the commitment.

maria: Ack. Do we have any dedicated/reserved capacity we can reassign temporarily? What's the SLA impact?

devon: We have a small spare Dedicated pool in eu-west that could be used as a temporary host, but VPC peering and routing will take ~48–72h.

sophie: @devon can you list the exact infra steps? If it's 3 days, we need a plan B for the first 7 days.

devon: Steps: 1) open infra ticket (INF-6523) to add VPC peering + firewall; 2) provision private endpoints in NovaHealth account; 3) sync KMS keys and run smoke test with a tiny model. ETA 48–72h after ticket approval.

ben: Also check if marketplace-hosted Dedicated mapping is allowed under contract as a fallback. @maria can you confirm customer consent requirements?

maria: On it. Contract says any offsite hosting needs explicit customer consent. I'll ping NovaHealth now.

partner_ops_bot: [Automated] GreenPeak manifest update: container C-784 changed ETA from 2026-04-08 to 2026-04-22. Tracking: GP-784-ETA-UPDATE.

alex: Thanks. Proposed fallback if customer agrees: 1) spin up temporary Dedicated in eu-west; 2) mirror configs and KMS; 3) cutover and migrate back when hardware arrives. Finance sign-off needed for delta costs.

maria: NovaHealth replied: okay with hosted fallback provided data-in-transit is encrypted and KMS is customer-managed. They asked for an EULA addendum.

sophie: Legal can draft an addendum template. @ben own the cost estimate and license checks; I'll own the rollout/rollback runbook. We also need an owner to trigger rollback when GP confirms delivery.

ben: Cost estimate attached to ticket — delta ~ $6k for two weeks. I'll flag Finance for expedited approval. Also verifying GreenPeak appliance licensing for KV cache offload; might be additional fee.

devon: Created INF-6523 and started firewall rule work; ETA 24h for initial peering changes. Posting link in ticket.

alex: Action items recap: maria (customer sign-off + EULA), ben (costs + license), devon (INF-6523 + peering), sophie (runbook + rollback). Ping in 4h for status. :thumbsup:

maria: Verbal confirmation received; customer to send formal note by 17:00. :white_check_mark:

partner_ops_bot: [Automated] Ticket INF-6523 created by devon. Link: https://rwi.atlassian.net/browse/INF-6523

devon: Firewall rules in progress, will update ticket with IP ranges and tests.

ben: Finance acknowledged the ticket; provisional approval pending formal EULA from Legal.

sophie: Runbook draft is in #eng-sre runbooks; scheduling a short dry-run tomorrow during low traffic window.

alex: Thanks team — keeping execs looped. Please close the loop once we have the signed EULA and infra smoke pass.
